stdout_truncated.description: True when the inline `stdout` string is a prefix: the capture cap dropped bytes, or the stream was not captured at all. Read the rest with `read_command_output` or from `stdout_path`.

stderr_truncated.description: True when the inline `stderr` string is a prefix. See `stdout_truncated`.

stdout_bytes.description: True size of the command's stdout in bytes, whatever the inline cap kept. `byte_count` is stdout plus stderr combined, so it cannot be compared against one stream.

stderr_bytes.description: True size of the command's stderr in bytes, whatever the inline cap kept.

truncation_notice.description: One sentence naming each truncated stream with its kept and omitted byte counts. Present only when a stream was truncated.
